verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's first-party webhook guide documents registrable outbound HTTP POST callbacks with JSON bodies sent to user-specified endpoints when events fire. You can filter which events you receive, create webhooks programmatically via a POST to the webhooks endpoint, and list them through the API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery and reliability (e.g. retries, signing).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Pipedrive will send this notification as an HTTP `POST` request, with a JSON body, to the endpoint(s) you specify.
With an event, you can filter what kind of events you want to receive
You can create a webhook programmatically by making a `POST` request to the webhook’s endpoint.
Returns data about all the Webhooks of a company.
